qualitative_review: Directly tests whether the perfect S6-perp-S9 negation is a modern codification artefact; needs a dated pre-modern corpus across three traditions with real philological risk.
uncertainties: Availability of citable translations for Latin/Ottoman/Ge'ez instruments; a thin sample would cut feasibility and rigor to 2-3.

qualitative_review: Converts the admitted no-kappa gap into a per-slot measured quantity and would expose which slot definitions cannot bear cross-system claims; no new data required.
uncertainties: Whether gloss-blind tagging is possible without gloss_en leakage; if not, both rigor and information gain fall by one.

qualitative_review: Gives the clearest structural finding a real document-level denominator and can show the fork is an aggregation artefact of hand-coded standards rather than of documents.
uncertainties: Multilingual detector accuracy and OCR quality on public corpora; detection failure in two script families would leave the claim untested.

qualitative_review: Mechanical verbatim-quote matching extends the existing gate cheaply; the likely outcome (most claims supported) is readable in advance so belief shift is limited.
uncertainties: Cross-lingual entailment quality on cheap models; more than 15 percent of verified claims unmatchable would raise information gain and lower feasibility.

qualitative_review: Turns the closed vocabulary into an experimental factor with sham controls and an obligation dose-prediction; the machine-legibility proxy limits how far headline beliefs move.
uncertainties: Whether full slot-complete documents can be assembled without layout artefacts; template-only stimuli would drop rigor to 2-3.

qualitative_review: A pre-registered cost outcome can move under the accuracy ceiling and give finding 5 its first positive or tight-null signal; new human participants and ethics review required.
uncertainties: Whether rt_ms is timed per question; coarse timing or a stalled ethics review would push feasibility to 2.

qualitative_review: Cheap CPU metric operationalises the unmeasured efficiency claim but the expected ranking (S12/S14 high) is readable from the repo and n=25 may only re-derive known caveats.
uncertainties: Whether permutation nulls swallow the signal at n=25; a surviving bias-corrected effect would raise information gain to 4.

qualitative_review: Within-standard edition diffs give a true longitudinal series separating 'modernity is the identifier' from corpus composition; superseded-edition retrieval is the hard gate.
uncertainties: Access to obsolete DIN/ДСТУ/ГОСТ editions; paywalled-only sources would drop feasibility to 1-2.

qualitative_review: One observed reform trajectory tests the carrier-shift mechanism with pre-stated stem-invariance predictions; a single lineage cannot separate medium effect from standard inertia.
uncertainties: Retrievability of Soviet-era and pre-2020 Ukrainian standard texts; blocked sources would cut feasibility to 2.

qualitative_review: Adds a citizen-supplied requisite column turning the burden question into a grammar count; one service per country makes national alternatives hard to separate.
uncertainties: Whether comparable service forms are retrievable behind Estonian login/geo limits; otherwise feasibility falls to 2.

qualitative_review: Blind recode of all four layers plus propagation turns an admitted caveat into bounded uncertainty on every headline number; machine-coder kappa is an untested proxy for human kappa.
uncertainties: Whether an LLM second coder's kappa tracks human kappa; if not the deliverable collapses into the already-planned two-coder pass.

qualitative_review: Exact enumeration with FDR adjudicates structural law versus sparse-sample absence for the headline fork; fully computable from the frozen matrix with nulls informative either way.
uncertainties: The null (independent versus tradition-blocked) must be fixed pre-analysis; an unblocked-only result would lower rigor by one.

qualitative_review: Permutation variance partition forces genre and tradition to compete on a pre-stated statistic — the criteria's named exemplar — after hand-coding genre for about 56 rows.
uncertainties: Whether requisites.csv carries a usable genre tag; hand-coding 56 rows plus tradition labels adds a coder-judgement layer.

qualitative_review: Wilson intervals plus a committed pre-coded hold-out prediction convert scoped universality into a scored out-of-sample test; the sampling frame choice is contestable.
uncertainties: Which hold-out system can be coded before commitment; retrieval failure would leave only the interval half of the deliverable.

qualitative_review: Re-derives the power surface over baseline and calibrates items pre-data so the registered verdict cannot be ceiling-determined; gates the human arm at negligible cost.
uncertainties: Whether machine item difficulty orders human difficulty; failure to predict even machine hold-outs would drop information gain.

qualitative_review: Codes the persistence/appraisal layer so the three regime dimensions become cross-tabulable and the orthogonality of the kinds-of-law catalogue becomes testable; source hunting is heavy.
uncertainties: Retention detail in existing case files; more than one third 'not found' cells would demote the layer and lower feasibility.

qualitative_review: Rubric-codes all 225 requisites for migration behaviour to test 'morphology survives; carriers do not'; single-coder subjective judgement with only a delayed self-recode as check.
uncertainties: Whether local_term/gloss_en retain substrate cues; heavy gloss-only rows would lower rigor to 2.

qualitative_review: Freezes the disclosed grounding tiers and re-tests three numbered claims on the primary-only subset — fully derivable from recompute.py; risk is an underpowered exact-count table.
uncertainties: How many strong anchors survive excluding regimes and boundary cases; n below 8 would widen uncertainty and lower information gain.

qualitative_review: Re-codes the boundary systems with a medium-neutral record grammar to test whether the deep grammar belongs to authoritative records or specifically to writing; sources are encyclopedia-thin.
uncertainties: Depth of sourcing for khipu/wampum and the third system; encyclopedia-only grounding would cap rigor at 3.

qualitative_review: Tests whether the state-centric regime catalogue gains a non-state stewardship dimension; the desk version is feasible but coding community texts without engagement risks the critique it targets.
uncertainties: Existence and retrievability of the frameworks (not searched this round); redundancy with access would collapse information gain.

qualitative_review: Adds a colonial-heritage variable and a permutation test of metropole-versus-region affinity — a genuine de-centring claim; needs 2-4 new metropole case files first.
uncertainties: Availability of GB/PT/BE metropole profiles in-corpus; building them costs time and lowers feasibility.

qualitative_review: Audits whether inclusion and grounding track open-web retrievability; an honest null is publishable but the idea adds no systems itself and needs an external universe list.
uncertainties: The external universe list and a pre-declared retrievability proxy; post-hoc proxy choice would lower rigor.

qualitative_review: Functionally codes deliberative notes to test whether the two-declension fork is a special case of a fuller paradigm; cross-linguistic single-coder genre identification is the weak point.
uncertainties: Whether the note genre is identifiable in at least 5 systems across three traditions; coverage failure kills the hypothesis.
